item.title: Reminder: You can self-verify your account by setting your domain as your username.
item.description:
Reminder: You can self-verify your account by setting your domain as your username.

Since we launched this feature in 2023, over 270,000 accounts have linked their Bluesky username to their website.

Here’s how:
How to verify your Bluesky account - Bluesky
Here's how to verify your Bluesky account by setting your website as your username.

item.title: As we roll out the app update today, you’ll start seeing blue checks appear in Bluesky.
item.description:
As we roll out the app update today, you’ll start seeing blue checks appear in Bluesky.

You can hide blue checks in your app in your account settings.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: We’re starting this initial roll-out with a small and non comprehensive group of accounts.
item.description:
We’re starting this initial roll-out with a small and non comprehensive group of accounts.

Currently, we are not accepting requests for verification. As the feature stabilizes based on feedback, we’ll launch a request form for account verification and trusted verifier status.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: When you tap on a verified account's check, you’ll see which organizations have granted verification.
item.description: When you tap on a verified account's check, you’ll see which organizations have granted verification.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: Trust doesn’t come only from the top down; it emerges from relationships, communities, and shared context.
item.description:
Trust doesn’t come only from the top down; it emerges from relationships, communities, and shared context.

That’s why we’re also enabling trusted verifiers: organizations that can directly issue blue checks. Trusted verifiers have a scalloped blue check.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: Bluesky will proactively verify authentic and notable accounts and display a blue check next to their names.
item.description: Bluesky will proactively verify authentic and notable accounts and display a blue check next to their names.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: We’re introducing a new layer of verification on Bluesky — a user-friendly, easily recognizable blue check.
item.description:
We’re introducing a new layer of verification on Bluesky — a user-friendly, easily recognizable blue check.

In addition to account verification issued by Bluesky, we're also introducing Trusted Verifiers. Select independent organizations can verify accounts directly.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: Wish that you spent your Friday doing something besides checking if TikTok was banned or not?
item.description:

Try out @skylight.social — a video app built upon the same open network as Bluesky. You can login with your Bluesky account, and all of your followers seamlessly come with you.
